H4428H.name: Hammelech
H4428H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4428H.brief: Father of Jerahmeel and Malchijah (or 'Malchiah'), officials during Jeremiah's time.
H4428H.short: Hammelech, meaning "the king," was the father of Jerahmeel and Malchijah (or 'Malchiah'), officials mentioned in the book of Jeremiah.

H4447G.name: Hammolecheth
H4447G.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4447G.brief: Sister of Gilead; mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
H4447G.short: Hammolecheth, the sister of Gilead, was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

H4401.name: Malachi
H4401.desc: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
H4401.brief: Prophet who wrote the book bearing his name.
H4401.short: Malachi, a prophet, received the word of the Lord to Israel.

H4445A.name: Malcam
H4445A.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4445A.short: Malcam was a son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite, born in Moab.

H4441S.name: Malchiah
H4441S.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4441S.brief: Son of Pashur, involved in plot against Jeremiah.
H4441S.short: Malchiah, son of Pashur, was involved in a plot against Jeremiah.

H4439.name: Malchiel
H4439.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4439.brief: Son of Beriah, grandson of Asher.
H4439.short: Malchiel, son of Beriah and grandson of Asher, was the ancestor of the Malchielites.

H4441I.name: Malchijah
H4441I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4441I.brief: Head of the fifth priestly division in David's time.
H4441I.short: Malchijah was the head of the fifth priestly division during David's reign.

H4441G.name: Malchijah
H4441G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4441G.brief: Son of Ethni, a Gershonite Levite.
H4441G.short: Malchijah, a son of Ethni, was a Gershonite Levite.

H4441H.name: Malchijah
H4441H.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441H.brief: Priest during the time of Nehemiah.
H4441H.short: Malchijah was a priest who served during Nehemiah's time.

H4441J.name: Malchijah
H4441J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441J.brief: Descendant of Parosh, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4441J.short: Malchijah, a descendant of Parosh, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4441K.name: Malchijah
H4441K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441K.brief: Descendant of Parosh, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4441K.short: Malchijah, known as Hashabiah in the LXX, a descendant of Parosh, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4441L.name: Malchijah
H4441L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441L.brief: Descendant of Harim, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4441L.short: Malchijah, a descendant of Harim, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4441Q.name: Malchijah
H4441Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441Q.brief: Priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H4441Q.short: Malchijah, a priest, was among those who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H4441R.name: Malchijah
H4441R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441R.brief: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
H4441R.short: Malchijah, a priest, participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H4441M.name: Malchijah
H4441M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441M.brief: Son of Harim, helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.
H4441M.short: Malchijah, son of Harim, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

H4441N.name: Malchijah
H4441N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441N.brief: Son of Rechab, repaired the Dung Gate in Jerusalem.
H4441N.short: Malchijah, son of Rechab, repaired the Dung Gate during Nehemiah's wall restoration.

H4441O.name: Malchijah
H4441O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441O.brief: Goldsmith who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.
H4441O.short: Malchijah, a goldsmith, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the Levites.

H4441P.name: Malchijah
H4441P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4441P.brief: Priest who stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law.
H4441P.short: Malchijah, a priest, stood beside Ezra as he read the Law to the people.

H4443.name: Malchiram
H4443.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4443.brief: Descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah.
H4443.short: Malchiram was a descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah.

H4444.name: Malchi-shua
H4444.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H4444.brief: Son of King Saul, killed in battle against the Philistines.
H4444.short: Malchi-shua, a son of King Saul, was killed in battle against the Philistines.

H4413.name: Mallothi
H4413.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4413.brief: Son of Heman, a musician in David's court.
H4413.short: Mallothi, a son of Heman, was a musician in David's court.

H4409G.name: Malluch
H4409G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4409G.brief: Son of Hashabiah, a Merarite Levite.
H4409G.short: Malluch, a son of Hashabiah, was a Merarite Levite.

H4409H.name: Malluch
H4409H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4409H.brief: Descendant of Bani, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4409H.short: Malluch, a descendant of Bani, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4409I.name: Malluch
H4409I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4409I.brief: Descendant of Harim, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4409I.short: Malluch, a descendant of Harim, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4409A.name: Malluch
H4409A.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4409A.brief: One who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H4409A.short: Malluch was among those who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H4409J.name: Malluch
H4409J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4409J.brief: Priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H4409J.short: Malluch, a priest, was among those who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H4471H.name: Mamre
H4471H.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4471H.short: Mamre was an Amorite and an ally of Abraham.

H4495.name: Manoah
H4495.desc: Samson's father living before Israel's Monarchy
H4495.brief: Father of Samson, from the tribe of Dan.
H4495.short: Manoah, Samson's father from the tribe of Dan, was visited by the Angel of the Lord who announced Samson's birth.

H4424.name: Melatiah
H4424.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4424.brief: Gibeonite who helped repair Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.
H4424.short: Melatiah the Gibeonite helped repair a section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's rebuilding project.

H4442.name: Melchizedek
H4442.desc: Priest living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4442.brief: King of Salem and priest of God Most High.
H4442.short: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, who blessed Abraham.

H4429.name: Melech
H4429.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H4429.short: Melech, a descendant of King Saul mentioned in the genealogies of Benjamin.

H4453.name: Melzar
H4453.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4453.brief: Babylonian official in charge of Daniel and his friends.
H4453.short: Melzar, the steward appointed by the chief eunuch to oversee Daniel and his companions.

H4462.name: Memucan
H4462.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4462.brief: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media.
H4462.short: Memucan, a wise prince who advised King Ahasuerus to depose Queen Vashti.

H4450.name: Milalai
H4450.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4450.brief: A priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
H4450.short: Milalai, a priest, was among the musicians who participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

H4435G.name: Milcah
H4435G.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4435G.short: Milcah, the daughter of Haran and wife of Nahor, was the mother of Bethuel and the grandmother of Rebekah.

H4435H.name: Milcah
H4435H.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4435H.brief: Daughter of Zelophehad, a descendant of Manasseh.
H4435H.short: Milcah, one of the five daughters of Zelophehad, was part of a significant case regarding inheritance rights for women in Israel.

H4436G.name: Queen of Sheba
H4436G.desc: Queen living at the time of United Monarchy
H4436G.brief: A queen who visited Solomon and praised his wisdom
H4436G.short: The Queen of Sheba visited King Solomon, tested him with questions, and praised his wisdom and prosperity.

H4428I.name: King's Highway
H4428I.brief: An ancient trade route through Edom and Moab
H4428I.short: The King's Highway, an ancient trade route through Edom and Moab, was the path the Israelites sought to use during their journey to Canaan (<ref="Numbers 20:17; 21:22">Numbers 20:17; 21:22</ref>).

H4428L.name: King's Valley
H4428L.brief: A valley near Salem (Jerusalem), site of significant events
H4428L.short: The King's Valley, located near Salem (Jerusalem), was the site where Melchizedek met Abraham and where Absalom erected a pillar for himself (<ref="Genesis 14:17; 2Sa.18.18">Genesis 14:17; 2Sa.18.18</ref>).

H4471G.name: Mamre
H4471G.brief: A place near Hebron; associated with Abraham
H4471G.short: Mamre, a place near Hebron where Abraham lived and built an altar to the Lord (<ref="Genesis 13:18; 18:1">Genesis 13:18; 18:1</ref>).

H4407.name: Millo
H4407.brief: A fortification in Jerusalem built by Solomon
H4407.short: Millo (Akra), a fortification in Jerusalem built by Solomon (<ref="1Ki.9.15, 24; 11:27">1Ki.9.15, 24; 11:27</ref>) and repaired by Hezekiah (<ref="2Ch.32.5">2Ch.32.5</ref>).

H4417G.name: Salt Sea
H4417G.brief: Another name for the Dead Sea
H4417G.short: The Salt Sea, also known as the Sea of Arabah, is another name for the Dead Sea, located at the lowest point on Earth (<ref="Gen. 14:3; Num. 34:3, 12; Deut. 3:17; Josh. 3:16; 12:3; 15:2, 5; 18:19; Deut. 4:49; 2Ki. 14:25">Gen. 14:3; Num. 34:3, 12; Deut. 3:17; Josh. 3:16; 12:3; 15:2, 5; 18:19; Deut. 4:49; 2Ki. 14:25</ref>).

H4417H.name: Salt Valley
H4417H.brief: Valley where David and his commanders defeated enemies
H4417H.short: The Salt Valley was a location where David and his commanders defeated the Edomites and Arameans (<ref="2Sa. 8:13; 2Ki. 14:7; 1Chr. 18:12; 2Chr. 25:11; Psa. 60:1">2Sa. 8:13; 2Ki. 14:7; 1Chr. 18:12; 2Chr. 25:11; Psa. 60:1</ref>).

H4432.name: Molech
H4432.brief: Canaanite deity associated with child sacrifice.
H4432.short: Molech (or Milcom or Moloch) was a Canaanite deity associated with child sacrifice.
